title: Surgical Tech Shirt - Unisex OR Team Scrub Tech Gift
description:
Eyebrow: SURGICAL TECH
Front print (center):
O.R. TEAM
ALL-STAR
Footer: SKILL FOCUS TEAMWORK

Celebrate the precise, steady, behind-the-scenes skill of the surgical technologist with a clean, wearable tee made for pride on and off shift. The design keeps a confident, professional look: bold, scoreboard-inspired lettering with subtle operating-room visual character (clean lines and a muted scrub-tone blue palette) so it reads like a team jersey without hospital branding.

Product details & verified facts:
- Unisex retail fit; front print.
- Fiber content varies by color.
- Printed to order by our production partner (Printful).
- Consult the listing size chart before ordering.

Use & occasions: Ideal for Surgical Technologist Week, graduations, new-job celebrations, coworker appreciation, birthdays, or holiday gift-giving. A positive coworker/appreciation gift that recognizes essential OR teamwork, composure, and precision.

Production & listing notes: This listing and the layout were created with AI-assisted design and listing copy. Final printing and fulfillment are handled by our print-on-demand production partner Printful.

Care: Follow the garment care instructions provided with your order to keep the print crisp and the tee comfortable. If you have sizing questions, check the size chart or message us before ordering.
rationale: Scoreboard style nods to the 'ALL-STAR' theme while staying professional; blue palette references scrub tones without hospital branding. Clean, bold typography emphasizes skill and teamwork; a minimal team-jersey approach keeps the tee wearable off-duty and giftable for graduations, Tech Week, or coworker celebrations.
